name: Jawla Core Flows
description: Tests login, health, routing, and auth protection for the Jawla field sales PWA

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/health and verify the page loads
Assert the health endpoint responds with OK or a healthy status (not a 500 error)
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/ and verify the root page loads
Assert the root page loads without a 500 error and is not blank
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/login and verify the login page renders
Assert the login page has a username/email input field, a password input field, and a submit button
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/login and verify the Filament admin login page loads
Assert the admin login page shows a login form with email and password fields
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app without being logged in
Assert that the unauthenticated user is redirected to the login page, not shown the app home
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin without being logged in
Assert that the admin panel redirects to the admin login page when not authenticated
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/offline and verify it loads
Assert the offline page loads without error and shows an offline/unavailable message
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/locale/ar to switch to Arabic
Assert the locale switch loads without error and the page is served in Arabic or redirects properly
